units.source_text: 源氏从此更加怜悯三公主，对她的照拂非常周到。

en.t: From then on, Genji felt even greater pity for the Third Princess and cared for her with the utmost attentiveness.

units.source_text: 朱雀院曾将三条地方的宫邸作为遗产赠与三公主，此时劝请源氏让她迁居，

en.t: The Suzaku Emperor had once given the Sanjo residence to the Third Princess as part of her inheritance, and now he urged Genji to let her move there,

units.source_text: 以为将来总须有此一日，不如现在分居，更合体统。

en.t: thinking that such a day would have to come eventually, and that it would be more proper for them to live apart now.

units.source_text: 但源氏答道：“两地分居，太疏远了。

en.t: But Genji replied, "Living separately in two places would make us far too distant.

units.source_text: 不能朝夕会晤，实非我之本意。

en.t: Not being able to see her morning and evening is truly not what I want.

units.source_text: 固然是‘我命本无常’，但在我住世期间，总希望不背我志。”

en.t: It is true that 'my life is by nature impermanent,' but while I remain in this world, I hope my wishes will not be opposed."

units.source_text: 一方面又命人修缮三条宫，务求尽善尽美。

en.t: At the same time, he ordered people to repair the Sanjo residence and saw to it that everything was made as perfect as possible.

units.source_text: 三公主领地内所产种种物品，以及各处庄院、牧场的贡物，凡贵重者，皆送入三条宫库藏中。

en.t: All the valuable goods produced on the Third Princess's estates, along with tribute from her various manors and pastures, were sent into the storehouses of the Sanjo residence.

units.source_text: 又添造库藏，将各种珍宝、朱雀院当作遗产赐赠的无数物品，

en.t: He also had additional storehouses built for the many treasures and countless articles that the Suzaku Emperor had bestowed as her inheritance,

units.source_text: 凡属于三公主者，均纳入库藏，令人严密保管。

en.t: and everything belonging to the Third Princess was placed in storage and put under strict guard.

units.source_text: 三公主日常用度、众侍女及上下人等一切费用，全由源氏负担，诸事迅速停当。

en.t: Genji bore all the expenses for the Third Princess's daily needs, her many ladies-in-waiting, and all her attendants, high and low, and everything was quickly put in order.
